silicon_quenching_2_subtask_structure_re.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 2
silicon_quenching_2_subtask_structure_re.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon (or a molten restart) and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_quenching_2_subtask_potential_fi.name: Silicon Potential File for Quenching - Level 2
silicon_quenching_2_subtask_potential_fi.description: Procure the appropriate Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

silicon_quenching_2_subtask_quenching.name: Silicon NPT Quenching - Level 2
silicon_quenching_2_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Silicon molten restart (or structure) and Stillinger–Weber potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching process by cooling the system under NPT. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg) as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes. Report the final Tg value in Kelvin.
